notes.title: 【Invercity#3】It's spoiler free, OK！Presenting『Streamer Mode』
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289022/86f6a657bc648cd2c28e184cfe1b05daace2007c.png[/img]

The inverse gravity puzzler「Invercity」was recently released.

In this issue, we will present equipment regarding『[b]Streamer Mode[/b]』.

※ What kind of game is「Invercity」any？Please read our first post→
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1943370/view/3388422300264389210]【Invercity #1】Release date now decided！[/url]



[h3]Streamers Mode is[/h3]

Ah, this game looks interesting！ I want to broadcast it！

But it is not good to post spoilers！！

Not sure which is considered to be called a spoiler...



[h2]I don't understand it at all～～！！[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289022/265cbd082e75dcb466dd7eac055ec0869e1c65a1.png[/img]

※A streamer spent 3 minutes recording the protagonist, Urara（permission granted）




『[b]Streamer Mode[/b]』was created from the desires of streamers.

As written on the Steam Store page:

[b]To post or stream images and videos using the play screen and audio are fully allowed. However, please always play with the in-game option "Streamer Mode" enabled.

※Only spoiler parts of the story will be automatically skipped. Captures in non-streamer mode can also be used by cutting the spoiler parts.[/b]

In other words, streamers can freely stream the game as long as this mode is enabled.

The game automatically skips spoilers we do not wish to be streamed, which would typically take some time to cut while editing. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289022/72cfe51caf34fc84f60e45033b44e667a5bdba36.png[/img]


It can only be switched on from the in-game option.

The rules are simple, so no worries about making mistakes.

It would be best if you have your own streaming channel to stream the game from.



[h3]A few more words from the developer[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289022/975cd6b1131d94ac668dad9c99e8865657d4fe72.png[/img] Marudice
The story event in the final stage is the only part that is skipped in『[b]Streamer Mode[/b]』. Streamers can enjoy the game midway with their audience, or they can work together to solve puzzles. We hope everyone will enjoy playing the game！



[h3]Afterwords[/h3]

And on that note,【Invercity #3】was presented this time, so what did you think of it?

Now is a great time to take a chance and stream this new release！

notes.title: Updated to v1.4
notes.content:
[h2]Functional improvements[/h2].
[list]
[*]Changed the language setting to use the OS system language on first startup.
[*]Fixed an issue where the cursor moves too fast in high frame rate environments, and revised the cursor movement speed.
[*]Fixed an issue where the remote controller could not be acquired at the position where the puzzle was just about to be cleared.
[*]Fixed an issue where the remote controller does not leave the puzzle when the player leaves the puzzle area to the left.
[*]Fixed a bug that was not reflected when switching move count display options while playing a puzzle.
[*]Reduced the size of player collisions slightly so that the player can now jump into a gap of one square.
[/list]

[h2]Minor fixes[/h2]
[list][/list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused boxes to move momentarily.
[*]Fixed a bug where skipping during a conversation would cause the studio to remain in the picture.
[*]Fixed an issue where retrying during a conversation would cause the game to stop advancing.
[*]Fixed an issue where skipping before the first puzzle of a stage would not skip correctly.
[*]W4-A-2: Fixed a decorating mistakes in the terrain.
[/list]
